QuestInfo.0:
#eReturn of the Toben Hair Hero#n
After absorbing all you had to teach like a sponge and then heading out into the world, the Toben Hair Hero has returned at last.
While he has grown in strength, what's grown even more is his newfound interest in fashion!
It falls to you, brave hero, to help him make his first fanciful foray into the fathomless world of fashion.
